act_title: The Goa, Daman and Diu (Administration) Act, 1962
title: Power to remove difficulties
text:
10. Power to remove difficulties.—(1) If any difficulty arises in giving effect to the provisions of

this Act or in connection with the administration of Goa, Daman and Diu, the Central Government may,
by order, make such further provision as appears to it to be necessary or expedient for removing the
difficulty.

(2) Any order under sub-section (1) may be made so as to be retrospective to any date not earlier than

the appointed day.
